agents.name: Research Agent
agents.description: Fills cognition's Research stages: extracts cited facts from Knowledge documents (/analyze), gathers new evidence from market, competitor, ad, community and review sources (/discover) and explains the blind spots (/gaps). Writes only proposed findings through the cognition API.

commands.name: /analyze
commands.description: Извади факти с цитати от документ в Knowledge

commands.name: /discover
commands.description: Намери нови доказателства: пазар, конкуренти, реклами, общности, отзиви

commands.name: /gaps
commands.description: Кои са белите петна и какво да проуча следващо
